notes: AEAT Manual practico de Renta 2024, Parte 1, Capitulo 14, 'Ejemplo 2. Pareja de hecho con hijos comunes, residentes en la Comunitat Valenciana', printed pages 1215-1216. Pareja de hecho conviviente, tres hijos comunes convivientes de 18, 12 y 6 anos; el hijo menor obtuvo 4.050 euros de rendimientos del capital mobiliario (L47457-L47461). In tributacion individual the manual prints Hijo 1 1.200 '(50% s/2.400)', Hijo 2 1.350 '(50% s/2.700)', Hijo 3 0, 'Total minimo por descendientes' 2.550 in the estatal column (L47481-L47487). This grounds the Art. 61 norma 2a own-return exclusion jointly with the norma 1a prorrateo. Nota (1) at L47490-L47496 states the rule verbatim and names the figure: the youngest child is obliged to file, and 'al presentar declaracion individual del IRPF con rentas superiores a 1.800 euros, no dara derecho a ninguno de sus padres a la aplicacion del minimo por descendientes'. NOT THE 8.000 CAP: 4.050 euros is BELOW the Art. 58.1 ceiling, so this child is eligible on rentas and is excluded solely by the norma 2a own-return rule. Conflating the two conditions here would ground the wrong provision. CCAA HAZARD, ESTATAL COLUMN ONLY: the manual's 'Nota previa' (L47466-L47468) states the Comunitat Valenciana DID exercise normative competence and increased the minimos, so the autonomico column carries divergent tranches (1.320 / 1.485, total 2.805). Only Comunidad de Madrid's divergent table is wired into the engine, so casilla 0514 resolves to the estatal figure for a Valencian filer and asserting 2.805 would fail for a reason unrelated to the eligibility predicate. This fixture therefore asserts casilla 0513 ONLY and deliberately omits 0514. THE CONJUNTA HALF OF THIS EXAMPLE IS NOT GROUNDED. AEAT prints 6.550 (L47510-L47512) = 1.200 + 1.350 + 4.000: hijos 1 and 2 stay prorated while hijo 3 takes the FULL tranche. Per nota (2) at L47521-L47523, absent a vinculo matrimonial the unidad familiar is one progenitor plus the minor children, so the other progenitor remains separately entitled to hijos 1 and 2 (hence the prorrateo), while hijo 3 sits inside the joint return whose rentas exceed 1.800, barring the other progenitor under norma 2a and leaving sole entitlement (hence the full tranche). That per-descendant unidad-familiar-membership fact is not modelled on the profile, so the engine cannot reproduce 6.550 today; it computes 4.550, an under-grant in the safe direction rather than the 9.100 over-grant it produced before this campaign. Recorded as a measured limitation, not asserted here.
